title: Duel: the original two-player split-screen race type
summary: Split-screen Race setup now offers Duel in the Event row (Single Player never does). A Duel is two players and no CPUs (CPU riders reads N/A), uses the Laps row with no Final Lap sign, and the winner is whoever finishes first. No points or profile credit are awarded. Shipped in PR #476 and live at furyremastered.com; part of issue #451.
details: Behavior comes from the exact USA v2.00 build (research/RACING.md, section Duel event type). Screenshots show the setup page (Event Duel, Laps 2, CPU riders N/A) and the split-screen finish with the Hall of Fame name entry. Verification: the new browser test test_engine_race_duel, which races a two-player Supercross Duel to the results, passes on the host and against furyremastered.com.
limitation: The two-player cap rests on the manual. The original's Duel results title was not traced, so the normal race results panel is kept. Only player 1 gets the Hall of Fame entry (#477). Copy ride link drops the event type (#473). Lap Attack is still to come.
